query: 预测一下明年（2026年）的订单总金额大概会是多少？

outcome.sql: WITH "yearly" AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "o"."order_date")::INT AS "yr", SUM("o"."amount")::NUMERIC AS "amt" FROM "public"."orders" "o" WHERE "o"."order_date" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "o"."order_date")), "reg" AS (SELECT regr_slope("amt", "yr")::NUMERIC AS "slope", regr_intercept("amt", "yr")::NUMERIC AS "intercept" FROM "yearly") SELECT "y"."year" AS "year", "y"."total_amount" AS "total_amount" FROM (SELECT "yr" AS "year", ROUND("amt", 2) AS "total_amount" FROM "yearly" UNION ALL SELECT 2026 AS "year", ROUND("r"."slope" * 2026 + "r"."intercept", 2) AS "total_amount" FROM "reg" "r") "y" ORDER BY "y"."year" LIMIT 40
